exercises.title: Data Validation with Lists
exercises.description: Validate multiple values in a list.
instructions: Create list ${numbers} with: 2, 4, 6, 8
Loop through the list with FOR ${num} IN @{numbers}
For each number, verify it's greater than 0
Use Should Be True    ${num} > 0
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Validate Numbers
    # Write code here
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Validate Numbers
    ${numbers}    Create List    2    4    6    8
    FOR    ${num}    IN    @{numbers}
        Should Be True    ${num} > 0
    END
hints: Create List makes a list variable

exercises.title: Dictionary Data Validation
instructions: Import Collections library
Create ${user} dict with: name=John, age=30, role=admin
Get value for 'role' and verify it equals 'admin'
Get value for 'age' and verify it's greater than 18

*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Validate User Data
    ${user}    Create Dictionary    name=John    age=30    role=admin
